title: projects rm refuses while the project has unfinished runs
lead: From the S17 review, not fixed. ork projects rm has no guard against unfinished runs, so removing a project can orphan a live run.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: From the S17 review, not fixed. ork projects rm has no guard against unfinished runs, so removing a project can orphan a live run.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- projects rm fails with the run ids when a run is not final.
- A project with only final runs is removed as before.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the failing test first in internal/daemon/daemon_test.go, beside TestProjectsAddListRemoveSaveTheRegistry (:659). Seed an unfinished run for the project the way TestRecoveryIgnoresFinishedRunsFromRemovedProjects (internal/daemon/runs_test.go:271) does. Expect projects.rm to fail with the new code and the run id in the message. A project whose runs are all committed or stopped is still removed.
2. Add `CodeProjectBusy = "project_busy"` to the code list in internal/daemon/wire.go:36-41 (*proposed* name; the existing literal "daemon_busy" is at runs.go:186).
3. In internal/daemon/handlers.go:289-306 (removeProject), after the not-found check at :296-299, lock d.runs.mu and list d.runs.deps.Store as engineRuns does (runs.go:417-431). Where the run is in d.runs.runs, use its engine snapshot (runs.go:427-429). Collect the IDs of runs with rec.Project == name and !runrec.IsFinal(rec.State) (record.go:36).
4. If any IDs were collected, return &ipc.Error{Code: CodeProjectBusy, Message: "project NAME has unfinished runs: ID, ..."} (*proposed* wording) before registry.Save at :301.
5. Lock order: removeProject holds d.regMu (handlers.go:290-291). regMu is taken only at handlers.go:273 and :290, so taking d.runs.mu inside it is safe. Keep it that way.
6. Add a case to TestProjectsRefusals (internal/cli/cli_test.go:374) that the CLI prints the message and exits with the code the other refusals use.
7. Update docs/design.md:94 (the projects.rm row) and :655 (the projects rm result) to name the refusal.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `go test -race -count=1 ./internal/daemon ./internal/cli`
- `go test -race -count=1 ./...`
- `go vet ./...`
- `gofmt -l .` (prints nothing)
- `slicer check`
- Tests by name: the new daemon test (TestProjectsRmRefusesAnUnfinishedRun, proposed), TestProjectsAddListRemoveSaveTheRegistry (internal/daemon/daemon_test.go:659), TestRemovedProjectIsNoLongerRead (:1098), and the new case in TestProjectsRefusals (internal/cli/cli_test.go:374).
